maddeler.e:
أستبطن (form X)
# أَسْتَبْطِنُ (ʔastabṭinu) /ʔas.tab.tˤi.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَبْطَنَ (istabṭana)
# أَسْتَبْطِنَ (ʔastabṭina) /ʔas.tab.tˤi.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَبْطَنَ (istabṭana)
# أَسْتَبْطِنْ (ʔastabṭin) /ʔas.tab.tˤin/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَبْطَنَ (istabṭana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
